name: Bag of Holding
Special Effect: Extradimensional space. Cannot store living creatures. Ruptures if overfilled.
Description: A common leather bag that opens into a small pocket dimension. Adventurers rely on these for hauling treasure.

name: Handy Haversack
Special Effect: Three side pockets each hold 20 lbs at no weight. Main compartment. Retrieve any item as a free action.
Description: A finely crafted leather backpack with three bulging side pockets. Whatever you need is always on top.

name: Portable Hole
Weight Reduction: Items stored inside have 0 weight while the hole is folded
Special Effect: Unfolded creates a 6ft x 10ft extradimensional pit. Cannot be placed on a Bag of Holding. Destroys both if combined.
Description: A circle of black fabric folded into a handkerchief. Unfold it on any surface to create a vertical portal to an extradimensional space.

name: Pouch of Plenty
Weight Reduction: Items inside weigh nothing for the carrier
Special Effect: Each dawn, produces 1d4 days of rations if empty. Items placed inside are preserved perfectly.
Description: A small velvet pouch with an embroidered wheat stalk. It always feels empty no matter how much you put in.

name: Devourer's Maw
Special Effect: 15% chance any organic item placed inside is consumed. Every full moon, the bag demands a blood sacrifice.
Description: A leather bag lined with what appears to be teeth. The drawstring is a long forked tongue. It seems... hungry.

name: Sovereign Satchel
Weight Reduction: Items inside have 0 weight. Bag itself has no weight.
Special Effect: Sentient. Can organize items magically by type. Allergic to mimics — the bag shakes violently if one is nearby. Grants +1 INT while worn.
Description: A shimmering silver satchel stitched with constellations that shift in real time. It hums softly when you open it.

name: Quiver of Ehlonna
Special Effect: Automatically replenishes standard ammunition each dawn (1d20 arrows). Draws the correct arrow type.
Description: A green-and-gold quiver adorned with leaf motifs. The inside is larger than the outside by a factor of ten.

name: Carpet of Carrying
Weight Reduction: Items placed on the carpet have no weight until removed
Special Effect: Can be rolled up with items inside (weight = 3 lbs rolled). Unrolls to a 6ft x 9ft flying carpet (speed 30).
Description: A thick wool carpet with geometric patterns. When unrolled, it hovers a few inches off the ground. Items stacked on it don't burden the owner.

name: Coin Purse of the Deep
Special Effect: Can only hold currency. Automatically sorts coins by denomination. Whisks coins inside when you drop them in.
Description: A small leather coin purse with a fish-scale pattern. No matter how many coins you put in, it never bulges.

name: Glove of Storage
Weight Reduction: One item stored in the glove has 0 weight
Special Effect: A single glove that can store exactly one item (any size up to 10 lbs). Retrieve as a free action. Disguises the stored item as a glove pocket.
Description: A supple leather glove with a single reinforced finger. Reach into the pocket and the item you stored is in your hand instantly.

name: Basket of Endless Harvest
Weight Reduction: Fruits and vegetables inside weigh 1/5th normal
Special Effect: Once per day, can reach in and pull out a seasonal fruit or vegetable. Contents rot at 1/10th normal speed.
Description: A simple woven basket that smells faintly of fresh apples. Farmers would pay a fortune for this.

name: Satchel of the Scholar
Weight Reduction: Books, scrolls, and papers inside weigh 1/10th normal
Special Effect: Tabs organize stored documents by subject. Waterproof. Can store up to 50 scrolls or 20 books.
Description: A sturdy leather satchel with brass fittings. Inside, leather tabs divide the space into labeled sections.

name: Jar of Infinite Pickles
Weight Reduction: Pickles stored inside have no weight
Special Effect: Produces one pickle per hour. Pickles never spoil. Pickles are slightly magical (+1 to morale checks when eaten).
Description: A glass jar labeled 'PICKLES' in faded ink. The brine inside sloshes perpetually. A pickle appears every hour on the hour.

name: Chest of the Void
Weight Reduction: Items inside have 0 weight. Chest weighs 5 lbs regardless of contents.
Special Effect: Can only be opened by its attuned owner. Impenetrable to divination magic. If forced open, all contents are lost to the void and the chest teleports to a random plane.
Description: An ornate chest carved from obsidian with platinum inlay. The lock has no keyhole — it opens only for its master. Stars swirl in its polished surface.

name: Elemental Vial
Weight Reduction: Elemental essences stored inside have no weight
Special Effect: Can store one elemental type at a time (fire, water, earth, air). Harvest ambient essence from elemental-rich areas. Uncorking releases a concentrated elemental effect.
Description: A crystal vial with a brass stopper. Tiny motes of energy dance inside, shifting color based on what element is contained.

name: Alchemist's Bandolier
Weight Reduction: Potions and elixirs stored have no weight
Special Effect: Each holster is padded and temperature-controlled. Quick-draw: retrieve a potion as a bonus action. Labels each slot automatically.
Description: A leather bandolier with 12 cylindrical holsters, each lined with velvet. The flap of each holster glows faintly when a potion is stored inside.
